passages.title: Peter, the Director of Photography
text: I’m Peter, the director of photography for this movie.
I’m in charge of all the cameras.
Today, Tom and Max are going to play together with a ball on the beach.
To capture their happy moments, I’m going to use drones.
koreanText: 오늘, Tom과 Max는 해변에서 공을 가지고 함께 놀 예정이에요.
그들의 행복한 순간을 포착하기 위해, 나는 드론을 사용할 거예요.
